gloss: principal image of worship (in a temple)

definitions.gloss: principal image of worship (in a Buddhist temple)
definitions.explanation: The main statue or image of a Buddha or deity enshrined and worshipped at a temple.

examples.japanese: {本尊|ほんぞん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拝|おが}む→拝む：00328_ogamu⟧。
examples.english: To pray before the principal image.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本尊|ほんぞん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{阿弥陀如来|あみだにょらい}だ。
examples.english: The principal image of this temple is Amida Buddha.

examples.japanese: ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧{秘仏|ひぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本尊|ほんぞん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{三十三年|さんじゅうさんねん}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The temple's secret principal image, normally hidden from view, was shown to the public for the first time in thirty-three years.

notes:
{本|ほん} (main) + {尊|ぞん} (revered one).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本尊|ほんぞん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拝|おが}む→拝む：00328_ogamu⟧: to worship the principal image
- {本尊|ほんぞん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安置|あんち}→安置：18721_anchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to enshrine the principal image
- {秘仏|ひぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本尊|ほんぞん}: a secret principal image, shown only rarely

USAGE:
With ご, ご{本尊|ほんぞん} is also used humorously for the person at the center of a matter: ⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ→騒ぎ：02827_sawagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{本尊|ほんぞん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}→涼しい顔：21639_suzushiikao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (the cause of all the fuss looks completely unbothered).
